% Inline tables: column names, an expression, comma separators, an empty
% line (jump) and unbounded cells (discarded). Behaviour V.
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[xlabel={$t$}, ylabel={value}]
  \addplot table [x=t, y=v] {
    t   v    w
    0   1.0  2
    1   1.5  nan
    2   0.5  3

    3   2.0  1
    4   2.5  inf
  };
  \addplot table [x expr=\thisrow{t}+0.5, y expr=\thisrowno{2}*0.8] {
    t   v    w
    0   1.0  2
    1   1.5  nan
    2   0.5  3
    3   2.0  1
  };
  \addplot table [col sep=comma, x index=0, y index=1] {
    a,b
    0, 3
    2, 2.2
    4, 3.1
  };
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
